summary: Operate and evolve CERN EOS distributed storage, troubleshoot across software/hardware/networks and improve automation, observability and reliability at exabyte scale.
requirements: Required: bachelor’s or master’s in software engineering or a related field, at most two years of professional experience after graduation by the application deadline, nationality of a CERN Member or Associate Member State, and no prior CERN fellow/graduate contract. PhD holders and applicants without a university degree are ineligible. Linux/network/storage knowledge, C++/Python/Git/CI-CD, collaboration and spoken/written English are expected; commit to learning French.
compensation: CHF 5,266 or 5,793 net per month, depending on degree, plus stated health/pension benefits and conditional family allowances.
conditions: International mobility: confirmed employer support. Brazil is a CERN Associate Member State, making Brazilian nationality eligible for this programme subject to the remaining criteria. Fully on-site in Geneva; 24-month contract, extendable up to 36 months. Forty hours per week; possible stand-by, night, Sunday and holiday work. Target start: 2027-01-01. Relocation installation/travel assistance is conditional on individual circumstances. The posting is active and its original releasedDate is within seven days. CERN membership source: https://home.cern/about/who-we-are/our-stakeholders
